name: Teppeki Country Restrictions for Woo
author: sampei1089

sections.description:
Restrict WooCommerce functionality by country.

This plugin allows you to control purchase eligibility by product, category, or tag.

The name “Teppeki” means “iron wall” in Japanese, symbolizing strong and reliable protection.

  • Product ID (highest priority)
  • Category
  • Tag

These rules can be combined in a layered manner, allowing flexible and precise control, with support for both whitelist and blacklist modes.

Restrictions are applied at both add-to-cart and checkout.

Unlike shipping-based restrictions, this plugin works independently of delivery settings and is suitable for digital products, license distribution, legal or regulatory compliance, and distributor agreements.

This plugin focuses on simplicity and performance.
It does not rely on IP detection or external services, and instead uses the customer’s selected country within the WooCommerce flow.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
